item.title: UMD SGA to host campuswide vote on renaming 10 campus buildings, rooms
item.description: The vote, which will be held during spring SGA elections, will ask students if they support renaming places named after U.S. defense companies, weapons manufacturers and people who supported slavery, segregation and homophobia.

item.title: New UMD Wellness Society chapter brings workouts, mindfulness and community to campus
item.description: With yoga mats, pressed juices and fun conversation, the club intends to create a welcoming and low-pressure environment to promote wellness.

item.title: Journalism faculty, staff urge UMD to drop sanctions against student journalists
item.description: The two student journalists were temporarily detained in October while covering an event hosted by this university’s Students Supporting Israel chapter.
